preconditions.description: The number of vertices in the first part, n1, is between 1 and 2000 inclusive.
The number of vertices in the second part, n2, is between 1 and 2000 inclusive.
The number of edges, m, is between 0 and 2000 inclusive.

preconditions.expression: all(1 <= ui <= n1 for ui, _ in edges)
preconditions.description: Each vertex index ui in the edges is between 1 and n1 inclusive.

preconditions.expression: all(1 <= vi <= n2 for _, vi in edges)
preconditions.description: Each vertex index vi in the edges is between 1 and n2 inclusive.

postconditions.expression: all(len(result[k]) == result[k][0] for k in range(minDegree + 1))
postconditions.description: Each line in the output starts with the number of edges in the minimal k-covering, followed by that many edge indices.

postconditions.expression: all(all(1 <= edge_index <= m for edge_index in result[k][1:]) for k in range(minDegree + 1))
postconditions.description: Each edge index in the output is between 1 and m inclusive.

postconditions.expression: all(len(set(result[k][1:])) == result[k][0] for k in range(minDegree + 1))
postconditions.description: Each set of edge indices in the output is unique.

postconditions.expression: all(all(sum(1 for u, v in edges if edge_index == i) >= k for edge_index in result[k][1:]) for k in range(minDegree + 1))
postconditions.description: Each minimal k-covering ensures that every vertex is incident to at least k edges.

postconditions.expression: all(len(result[k]) == 0 or result[k][0] == min(len(subset) for subset in subsets if all(sum(1 for u, v in edges if edge_index in subset) >= k for edge_index in range(1, m + 1))) for k in range(minDegree + 1))
postconditions.description: Each minimal k-covering is of minimal size.
